import torch

def _mat(n, dtype, device):
    A = torch.zeros(2 * n, n, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    for i in range(2 * n):
        src = max((i + 0.5) * 0.5 - 0.5, 0.0)
        i0 = min(int(src), n - 1)
        i1 = min(i0 + 1, n - 1)
        l = round((src - i0) * 4) / 4
        A[i, i0] += 1 - l
        A[i, i1] += l
    return A

    Aw = _mat(w, x.dtype, x.device)
    return torch.einsum('ih,chw,jw->cij', Ah, x, Aw)
